```{r setup}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# National Data — single-topic downloadable view
#
# This template is rendered on demand by the National Data Shiny app when the
# user clicks "Download Selected Topic". All substantive content (map, table,
# titles, notes) is prepared by the app and passed in via a single RDS bundle
# so this document only handles presentation and ADA-PARC branding. Keeping the
# data logic in the app is the single source of truth: what downloads always
# matches what is on screen.
#
# Bundle contents (see server downloadHandler in ADA_PARC.Rmd):
#   title        cleaned topic title (character)
#   category     category label, e.g. "Demographics" (character)
#   interp_note  interpretation note or "" (character)
#   source_note  data source sentence (character)
#   alt_text     plain-language map summary for accessibility (character)
#   table_df     formatted data frame, first column "State" (data.frame)
#   map_svg      the state map as inline SVG markup (character)
#   generated    date string (character)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
options(cli.width = 80)

library(htmltools)
library(knitr)

b <- tryCatch(readRDS(params$bundle), error = function(e) NULL)

ok <- !is.null(b) &&
  all(c("title", "table_df", "map_svg") %in% names(b))

# Small helpers with safe fallbacks
val <- function(name, default = "") {
  if (ok && !is.null(b[[name]]) && length(b[[name]]) == 1 &&
      !is.na(b[[name]]) && nzchar(trimws(b[[name]]))) b[[name]] else default
}
```

```{css}
:root {
  --adaparc-maroon: #6d1f2e;
  --adaparc-gold:   #c9a84c;
  --adaparc-ink:    #1c2b3a;
}

body {
  font-family: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, serif;
  color: #111;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 8.5in;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 0.5in 0.75in 0.5in;
}

/* ── Brand banner ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.adaparc-banner {
  background: var(--adaparc-maroon);
  color: #ffffff;
  border-bottom: 5px solid var(--adaparc-gold);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 0 0 1.25rem 0;
}
.adaparc-banner .brand {
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  margin: 0;
}
.adaparc-banner .sub {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  margin: 0.15rem 0 0 0;
  color: #f3e6c9;
}

h1.topic-title {
  color: var(--adaparc-maroon);
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.75rem 0;
}
h2.section-title {
  color: var(--adaparc-maroon);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.75rem 0;
}
h2.section-title-continued { font-size: 1.25rem; }
h2.section-title .continued { font-weight: 500; color: #555; }

/* ── Interpretation note ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.interp-note {
  background: #f9f7f4;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--adaparc-gold);
  padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
  margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
}
.interp-note .label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--adaparc-maroon); }

/* ── Map figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.map-figure { margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem 0; text-align: center; }
.map-figure svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.map-summary {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: #333;
  margin: 0.5rem auto 0 auto;
  max-width: 7in;
  text-align: left;
}
.map-summary .label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--adaparc-ink); }

.source-note {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #444;
  margin: 0.75rem 0 0 0;
}
.source-note .label { font-weight: 700; }

/* ── Data table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.table-wrap { margin-top: 0.5rem; overflow-x: auto; }
table.national-table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
  font-size: 1rem;
}
table.national-table thead th {
  background: var(--adaparc-maroon);
  color: #ffffff;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--adaparc-maroon);
  font-weight: 700;
}
table.national-table tbody td {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #d9d4c9;
  text-align: right;
}
table.national-table tbody td:first-child {
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 600;
}
table.national-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f6f3ee; }
table.national-table thead th:not(:first-child) { text-align: right; }

/* ── Footer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.adaparc-footer {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding-top: 0.75rem;
  border-top: 2px solid var(--adaparc-gold);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #555;
}

/* ── "See next page" note ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.see-next {
  margin: 1.25rem 0 0 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--adaparc-maroon);
}

/* ── Screen-only print helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.print-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
}
.btn-print {
  font-family: 'EB Garamond', Garamond, Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: var(--adaparc-maroon);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--adaparc-maroon);
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 8px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-print:hover { background: #8b2737; border-color: #8b2737; }
.btn-print:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--adaparc-gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ── Pagination: map on page 1, table from page 2 ─────────────────────────── */
/* An explicit page box gives print/PDF engines a defined page size so the
   break below is actually paginated (without @page, some "save to PDF" paths
   lay the whole document on one continuous page and ignore the break). */
@page {
  size: Letter;
  margin: 0.6in 0.5in;
}
.page-two {
  break-before: page;
  page-break-before: always;
}

@media print {
  /* Quarto wraps the document in #quarto-content.page-columns, which is a CSS
     grid, and main.content is one of its grid items. Chromium does not
     fragment grid containers: it lays the whole grid out monolithically and
     drops forced breaks inside it, which is why "Save as PDF" was returning a
     single clipped page. Restoring normal block layout for print puts the
     document back on the standard fragmentation path so @page and
     .page-two are honored. */
  #quarto-content,
  #quarto-content.page-columns,
  .page-columns,
  main.content,
  main#quarto-document-content,
  .cell {
    display: block !important;
    grid-template-columns: none !important;
  }

  .print-bar { display: none !important; }

  body { max-width: none; padding: 0; font-size: 12pt; }

  /* Backgrounds carry meaning here (brand banner, table header, zebra rows),
     so ask the engine to print them rather than drop them. */
  body,
  .adaparc-banner,
  table.national-table thead th,
  table.national-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
    print-color-adjust: exact;
  }

  /* Page one budget: the banner, title, note, map, summary and source note
     have to clear 9.8in of content box. The map is exported at 9 x 6.4in, so
     unconstrained it renders ~5.3in tall and pushes the closing lines onto a
     stray page of their own. Fixing its printed height (width follows from the
     viewBox aspect ratio) leaves room for the text below it. */
  .adaparc-banner { padding: 0.7rem 1rem; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
  h1.topic-title { font-size: 17pt; margin: 0 0 0.45rem 0; }
  .interp-note { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem; }
  .map-figure { margin: 0.3rem 0 0.5rem 0; }
  .map-figure svg {
    height: 4.3in !important;
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
  }
  .map-summary { margin-top: 0.3rem; }
  .source-note { margin-top: 0.45rem; }
  .see-next { margin-top: 0.6rem; break-inside: avoid; }

  /* Page two onward: 52 rows of five columns will not fit on a single sheet at
     a readable size, so the table flows across two pages with the column
     header repeated and no row split across the break.

     The wrapper has to drop its horizontal scroll first. Any ancestor with a
     non-visible overflow is a monolithic fragmentation context in Chromium:
     the table cannot be split, so the overflow is clipped at the page edge
     (the "cut off" rows) and the header group is never re-emitted on the
     following page. Bootstrap's .cell-output-display and .table-responsive
     carry the same overflow-x, so they are reset alongside .table-wrap. */
  .table-wrap,
  .cell-output-display,
  .knitsql-table,
  .table-responsive,
  .page-two {
    overflow: visible !important;
  }

  /* Each block is one printed page of the table, carrying its own header. */
  .table-page-next {
    break-before: page;
    page-break-before: always;
  }
  .table-page { break-inside: auto; }

  h2.section-title { font-size: 14pt; break-after: avoid; }
  h2.section-title-continued { font-size: 12pt; }
  table.national-table { font-size: 9.5pt; break-inside: auto; }
  table.national-table thead th { padding: 4px 8px; }
  table.national-table tbody td { padding: 2px 8px; }
  /* Explicit groups: the header repeats on every page the table spans, and
     the body stays a normal fragmentable row group. */
  table.national-table thead { display: table-header-group !important; }
  table.national-table tbody { display: table-row-group !important; }
  table.national-table tr {
    break-inside: avoid;
    page-break-inside: avoid;
  }
  .adaparc-footer { break-inside: avoid; }
  a[href]:after { content: ""; }
}
```

```{r banner, results='asis'}
if (!ok) {
  cat('<div class="adaparc-banner"><p class="brand">ADA-PARC</p>',
      '<p class="sub">National Data</p></div>',
      '<p>No topic was provided to render. Please return to the ',
      'National Data page and try again.</p>')
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::div(
    class = "adaparc-banner",
    htmltools::p(class = "brand", "ADA-PARC"),
    htmltools::p(
      class = "sub",
      paste0("National Data",
             if (nzchar(val("category"))) paste0("  ·  ", val("category")) else "")
    )
  )
) |> as.character() |> cat()
```

```{r page-one, results='asis'}
# Screen-only print control. Hidden in print via .print-bar, so it never
# appears in the saved PDF. The background-graphics tip matters because the
# banner, table header and zebra rows are colour-coded.
cat(paste0(
  '<div class="print-bar">',
  '<button type="button" class="btn-print" onclick="window.print()">',
  'Print or save as PDF</button>',
  '</div>\n'
))

# Topic title
cat(sprintf('<h1 class="topic-title">%s</h1>\n', htmltools::htmlEscape(val("title"))))

# Interpretation note (only present for directional indicators)
if (nzchar(val("interp_note"))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="interp-note"><span class="label">Interpretation Note: </span>%s</div>\n',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(val("interp_note"))
  ))
}

# Map (inline SVG, already contains the legend/key)
cat('<div class="map-figure" role="img" aria-label="',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(val("alt_text", "State-by-state map of the selected topic."), attribute = TRUE),
    '">\n', sep = "")
cat(b$map_svg)
cat('\n</div>\n')

# Accessible plain-language summary
if (nzchar(val("alt_text"))) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<p class="map-summary"><span class="label">Summary: </span>%s</p>\n',
    htmltools::htmlEscape(val("alt_text"))
  ))
}

# Source note
cat(sprintf(
  '<p class="source-note"><span class="label">This indicator sourced from: </span>%s</p>\n',
  htmltools::htmlEscape(val("source_note", "2020-2024 American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates"))
))

# End-of-page-one pointer to the table, which starts on page 2
cat('<p class="see-next">Data table begins on the next page.</p>\n')
```

```{r page-two, results='asis'}
# ── Data table, split into one table per printed page ───────────────────────
# A single long table with one <thead> relies on the print engine repeating
# the header group on continuation pages. Chromium and Firefox do; WebKit
# (Safari, and therefore macOS "Export as PDF") does not, and has never
# implemented it, so the second table page arrived headerless. Emitting each
# page's rows as its own table with its own header makes the result identical
# in every engine and in any HTML-to-PDF converter, at the cost of choosing
# the split point here rather than letting the engine choose it.
#
# ROWS_PER_PAGE is the measured capacity of one Letter page at the print
# styles set above: heading + header row + rows, with the last page also
# carrying the footer. National tables run 53 rows (US, 50 states, DC, PR),
# so this yields two balanced pages of roughly 27 rows.
ROWS_PER_PAGE <- 27L

cat('<div class="page-two">\n')

df <- b$table_df
# First column left-aligned, all others right-aligned
aligns <- c("l", rep("r", max(0, ncol(df) - 1)))

n_rows  <- nrow(df)
n_pages <- max(1L, as.integer(ceiling(n_rows / ROWS_PER_PAGE)))
# Balance the pages rather than filling the first to capacity and leaving a
# stub on the last one.
per_page <- as.integer(ceiling(n_rows / n_pages))
groups   <- split(seq_len(n_rows), ceiling(seq_len(n_rows) / per_page))

title_esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape(val("title"))

for (k in seq_along(groups)) {
  # The first block inherits the page break from .page-two; each later block
  # carries its own.
  cat(sprintf('<div class="table-page%s">\n',
              if (k == 1) "" else " table-page-next"))

  if (k == 1) {
    cat(sprintf('<h2 class="section-title">Data Table: %s</h2>\n', title_esc))
  } else {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<h2 class="section-title section-title-continued">Data Table: %s <span class="continued">(continued)</span></h2>\n',
      title_esc
    ))
  }

  chunk <- df[groups[[k]], , drop = FALSE]

  tbl_html <- knitr::kable(
    chunk,
    format     = "html",
    align      = aligns,
    escape     = TRUE,
    row.names  = FALSE,   # subsetting leaves non-sequential row names behind
    table.attr = 'class="national-table"'
  )

  cat('<div class="table-wrap">\n')
  cat(tbl_html)
  cat('\n</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r footer, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  paste0('<div class="adaparc-footer">ADA-PARC  ·  ADA Participation Action ',
         'Consortium  ·  Generated %s. Darker map colors always indicate more ',
         'opportunity.</div>'),
  htmltools::htmlEscape(val("generated", format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")))
))

# Close the .page-two wrapper opened in the page-two chunk so the table and
# this footer note stay grouped on the second page.
cat('</div>\n')
```
